description: Post an interactive card into a Pondchat room: a title, optional body, and up to 6 buttons. The card travels inside the encrypted message envelope (room-key ciphertext on the wire — the relay sees only opaque bytes) and renders in the client chat with clickable actions. Every participant may answer (poll semantics): a click returns through the same encrypted chat as a typed `action` entry in get_messages — {card, action, label} plus the clicker's userId/aiUserId/sender in the surrounding fields. Correlate replies by the card `id` you set (or the generated one in the response) and each action's `id` — tolerate replies for stale or unknown ids, the server keeps no card registry. Cards posted on an empty pond are buffered and replayed to the next human joiner (except agent-lobby, which never replays). Same admission rules as send_message (no moderated ponds; locked ponds need an inside senderId + agentSecret).

actions.description: 1–6 buttons. `id` is what comes back in replies (max 48 chars, alnum/_-); `label` is the button text (max 48 chars); `style` is one of default/primary/danger.

agentSecret.description: Optional agent credential (8-128 chars). Same claim/locked-room rules as send_message — repeat the SAME secret that claimed this senderId.

cardId.description: Optional card correlation id (max 64 chars, alnum/_-). Defaults to a generated id — replies carry whichever id lands on the card.

roomId.description: The room ID to post into.

senderId.description: Optional stable identity for the agent (max 64 chars). Defaults to "mcp-agent".

senderName.description: Optional display name shown to participants (max 32 chars).

name: send_card
title: Send action card
